plan.estimand: Main effect of 2-level factor in balanced 3-by-2 factorial design with 6 cell means, testing at 1 numerator degree of freedom
plan.hypothesis: The 2-level factor has a non-zero main effect across the 3 levels of the other factor
assumptions: Balanced design with equal participants per cell
Common variance across all cells (homogeneity of variance)
Testing main effect of 2-level factor with 1 numerator df
missing_information: Specification of denominator degrees of freedom: for n participants per cell, df_denominator = 6(n-1) = 6n - 6 based on balanced 3×2 factorial with independent observations
clarification_questions: The denominator df will be calculated as 6(n-1) where n is participants per cell. This assumes participants are independent observations nested within the 6 factorial cells. Confirm this is the intended design structure.
scientific_notes: Partial eta-squared (η²_p) = 0.06 represents the proportion of variance in the dependent variable explained by the 2-level factor main effect
Cohen's f equivalent: f = √(η²_p / (1 - η²_p)) ≈ 0.2532 for η²_p = 0.06
Non-centrality λ for F-test: λ = f² × (df_denominator + df_numerator) / df_numerator when expressed in terms of effect size f
